The '''Government Compound''' was the home of [[Glova]]'s government, in [[Drepplin]], the capital city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Characteristic==
The compound was surrounded by a two meter tall stone fence, although no other security precautions are evident. The [[Governor's House|governor's house]] was the original building, and all other buildings in the compound were haphazardly added, giving the whole area a disjointed, unorganized appearance.
